name: Algen
source:
Deacon of the Light Church, a judge who shows wandering souls the way.
After discovering the the good deeds done while they were alive he leads the righteous souls who hold purity to Heaven.
He respects order and justice, he's a gentle and honest angel who loves nature and peace.
